bug_semantics: AsyncListener.handle_query_or_defer accepted unauthenticated LAN-local TC-bit mDNS queries and retained each byte-distinct DNSIncoming in a per-source _deferred list while also retaining a timer per source. Neither the per-source list nor the number of spoofable source-address keys was capped; the reverse linear duplicate scan additionally made a same-source flood consume quadratic CPU before the roughly 500 ms flush, while many spoofed sources could grow retained packet and timer state until memory exhaustion.
flaw_origin: The flaw originated in the first public member of PR #687, 3b8d906177bc6d951c80b9388aa8ceb3066cb3cf, which first added the TC branch, self._deferred.setdefault(addr, []).append(msg), and delayed processing without any resource cap. Its direct parent e816053af4d900f57100c07c48f384165ba28b9a has none of _deferred, _timers, msg.truncated, or the TC delay mechanism. Later members made the queue operational and added deduplication, and GitHub squash-merged the 25-member PR as 8a25a44ec5e4f21c6bdb282fefb8f6c2d296a70b; subsequent commits only moved/refined the surviving mechanism until the security fix.
ai_marker: absent: the BIC commit object names author and committer J. Nick Koston <nick@koston.org>, has message 'Implement multi-packet known answer supression', and contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI, or bot marker
evidence: GitHub PR API https://api.github.com/repos/python-zeroconf/python-zeroconf/pulls/687 reports a merged 25-commit PR whose squash merge is 8a25a44ec5e4f21c6bdb282fefb8f6c2d296a70b; /pulls/687/commits exposes all member SHAs listed in decomposed_shas.

GitHub commit API for 3b8d906177bc6d951c80b9388aa8ceb3066cb3cf shows zeroconf/_core.py first adding the msg.truncated branch and self._deferred.setdefault(addr, []).append(msg), with direct parent e816053af4d900f57100c07c48f384165ba28b9a.

Direct retrieval and token search of e816053af4d900f57100c07c48f384165ba28b9a:zeroconf/_core.py found none of _deferred, _timers, msg.truncated, or TC_DELAY_RANDOM_INTERVAL, directly verifying parent-tree absence.

The PR-final 5b164f7ac60497ead438468fb8c7ae9b0282a88a zeroconf/_core.py and squash 8a25a44ec5e4f21c6bdb282fefb8f6c2d296a70b zeroconf/_core.py have the identical SHA-256 339faf163228179138115dafcf28b0c18657bb6e730acff9e29fc9f6c9f45eb0, tying the decomposed member history to the landed tree.

git blame across zeroconf/_core.py, src/zeroconf/_engine.py, and src/zeroconf/_listener.py traces the unbounded setdefault/list append and reverse duplicate scan through later per-interface and file-split moves back to PR #687 rather than treating those moves as introducers.

BIC git object/API metadata for 3b8d906177bc6d951c80b9388aa8ceb3066cb3cf records human author and committer J. Nick Koston <nick@koston.org>, an unsigned ordinary message, and no AI/co-author/generated trailer or bot identity.

CVE.org record https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-48045 is PUBLISHED and describes adjacent-network unauthenticated growth of _deferred/_timers, memory exhaustion, and quadratic CPU burn; it identifies <0.149.12 as affected and 0.149.12 as fixed.

Current GitHub advisory API https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-9663-mqmp-p9mm has withdrawn_at=null, vulnerable range <0.149.12, first patched version 0.149.12, and references direct fix b22c8ff19c66c68907d220a4823c0950f4fa93f7.

git show b22c8ff19c66c68907d220a4823c0950f4fa93f7 shows the direct fix adding _MAX_DEFERRED_PER_ADDR=16, _MAX_DEFERRED_ADDRS=512, per-address dropping, and FIFO source eviction in src/zeroconf/_listener.py and src/zeroconf/const.py.

Tag ancestry verifies the landed introducer aggregate first appears in 0.32.0; 0.149.11 contains the vulnerable lineage but not b22c8ff19c66c68907d220a4823c0950f4fa93f7, while 0.149.12 contains that fix.
reasoning: The advisory is a real, published resource-exhaustion vulnerability: TC-bit mDNS packets enter a deferred reassembly path before response processing, and attacker-controlled byte-distinct packets and spoofed source addresses populate uncapped lists, dictionaries, and timers; the reverse dedup scan adds CPU amplification. History tracing shows that the 2023 file splits and the 2021 per-interface refactor merely moved this mechanism. PR #687 is reconstructable despite squash merge: its first member 3b8d906177bc6d951c80b9388aa8ceb3066cb3cf first wrote the uncapped retention branch, its immediate parent lacks that branch and state, later members preserve and complete it, and the PR-final core file exactly matches the squash-landed file. The fix directly imposes both resource bounds and ships at the documented patched boundary. AI attribution is evaluated only on that atomic BIC member; its commit object identifies a human author/committer and contains no AI marker, so the causal verdict is NOT_AI.
